source_text:
17.41 Καὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ε δωκάς μοι
νῶτον. ̓Αντὶ τοῦ· εἰς φυγὴν ε τρεψας. Ιδιον γὰρ φευγόντων τὸ διδόναι τὰ νῶτα.
pass_a_gloss: And the enemies of-me you-gave to-me back. Instead of: into flight you-turned. Proper for of-fleeing-ones the to-give the backs.
pass_b_english: “And my enemies you gave me the back” (Psalm 17:41).
That is: you turned them to flight. For it is proper to those fleeing to give their backs.

choices.why: Enemies turned their backs. νῶτον is back, not νόμον ‘law’.
The gloss of giving the back. OCR ε τρεψας. Not ‘you turned into a flight of birds’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
